tooltip.ezextrelytr.forward_boost: Controls base forward velocity boost (0.05 to 3.00).
tooltip.ezextrelytr.nitro_multiplier: Multiplier applied when holding Sprint/Nitro (1.1x to 3.0x).
tooltip.ezextrelytr.brake_force: Percentage of velocity reduced per tick when braking (5% to 50%).
tooltip.ezextrelytr.particle_amount: Sets maximum number of particles per tick. Set to 0 to disable.
tooltip.ezextrelytr.sound_volume: Volume level for boost and brake audio effects.
